 Quick summary - click for full details Concise summary of key highlights Reliance Jio launches 3-year 5G unlimited prepaid plan ahead of Diwali
 In one line Reliance Jio launches a new three-year unlimited 5G prepaid plan ahead of Diwali, featuring bundled OTT and AI tool subscriptions. Key highlights • Three-year 5G prepaid plan Reliance Jio has introduced a long-term plan offering unlimited 5G data capped at 2.5 GB per day, unlimited voice calling, and 100 SMS per day. • Bundled entertainment and AI Subscribers receive JioHotstar Mobile + Hollywood access, Canva Pro Lite with 50GB cloud storage, and 50GB of JioAICloud storage. • Anniversary and festive offers The launch coincides with rollout offers leading up to Jio's 10th anniversary in 2026, including various voice-only and data packs. Key statistics 3 years Plan validity 2.5 GB Daily 5G data cap 50GB Canva cloud storage 50 GB JioAICloud complimentary storage 2026 Milestone anniversary year Processed with AI.
